WITH transaction_sentiment AS (
  SELECT
    t.transreg,
    t.ordertypedist,
    AVG(s.shortintrt) AS avg_short_interest_days_to_cover,
    AVG(s.optvolrt) AS avg_option_volume_ratio
  FROM transactionrecord AS t
  JOIN sentimentandfundamentals AS s
    ON s.transref = t.transreg
  GROUP BY t.transreg, t.ordertypedist
),
order_type_averages AS (
  SELECT
    ordertypedist,
    AVG(avg_short_interest_days_to_cover) AS order_type_avg_short_interest
  FROM transaction_sentiment
  GROUP BY ordertypedist
)
SELECT
  ts.transreg AS transaction_reference,
  ts.ordertypedist AS order_type_mix,
  ts.avg_short_interest_days_to_cover,
  ts.avg_option_volume_ratio,
  ts.avg_short_interest_days_to_cover / ota.order_type_avg_short_interest AS short_interest_ratio
FROM transaction_sentiment AS ts
LEFT JOIN order_type_averages AS ota
  ON ota.ordertypedist = ts.ordertypedist
ORDER BY short_interest_ratio DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10
